# chrome commands

Add a `chrome` helper for the Chrome settings the author keeps toggling:

```bash
$ chrome swipe enable
# defaults write com.google.Chrome AppleEnableSwipeNavigateWithScrolls -bool TRUE
$ chrome swipe disable
# defaults write com.google.Chrome AppleEnableSwipeNavigateWithScrolls -bool FALSE
$ chrome open
$ chrome open http://
```

The swipe toggle controls two-finger back/forward navigation, which misfires in web apps such as Miro; `open` launches Chrome with an optional URL.
